title: Introduction to Vector Search
author: Alice Chen
body: Vector search uses dense embeddings to find semantically similar documents. Unlike keyword search it understands meaning not just exact words.

title: Building REST APIs with Python
author: Bob Martinez
body: FastAPI makes it easy to build production-ready REST APIs. Start with a simple endpoint and add validation with Pydantic models.

title: Understanding Database Indexing
author: Carol Wu
body: Database indexes speed up queries by creating sorted data structures. B-tree indexes are most common but hash indexes work well for equality lookups.

title: Kubernetes for Beginners
author: Dave Patel
body: Kubernetes orchestrates containerized applications across clusters. Pods are the smallest deployable units and Services expose them to the network.

title: Natural Language Processing Basics
author: Eve Johnson
body: NLP combines linguistics and machine learning to help computers understand human language. Tokenization and embeddings are fundamental concepts.
